name: Party Detail 1
definition: Specifies further details of the party.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Country of the party as recorded in the registration in its legal jurisdiction.

PartyType.name: Party Type
PartyType.definition: Code indicating the type of party as per local regulation.

SupervisingAuthority.name: Supervising Authority
SupervisingAuthority.definition: Information detail about the institution supervising the party under the local regulation.

PostalAddress.name: Postal Address
PostalAddress.definition: Address used to communicate with the party as recorded in the registration in its legal jurisdiction.

Contact.name: Contact
Contact.definition: Communication device number or electronic address used for communicating with the party.

Comment.name: Comment
Comment.definition: Any other additional information about the party.
